description: This file is the entry point for a React application. It imports React and ReactDOM, along with CSS and the main App component. It initializes the React root and renders the App component within React.StrictMode into the DOM element with id 'root'.

methods.name: ReactDOM.createRoot
methods.description: Creates a root for React rendering in the specified DOM element.

methods.name: root.render
methods.description: Renders the React component tree into the root.
